backend.note: backend throughput, not native device or UI latency

method: Cold app analysis cache and fresh project/PCM; OS cache not purged. Warm feedback measures input event timestamp → terminal dirty strip of full-resolution canvas draw, waits until all tile statuses clear, invalidates superseded draw callbacks → two animation frames (paint opportunity). No first-strip/preview sample. Distinct ten-minute 48kHz 6ch and 2ch sources; real native device output. Memory queries only retain the owned native/WebView2 tree; one-second wait follows each process query, with actual intervals reported.

window.densityMethod: Actual Windows display density; no CDP override in performance run
